name: Pagination
layerWhy: It moves through one list; moving is never a job.
promise: Each page of the same list is one press away, and this one is marked.
expectation: Previous, the pages near yours, the first and last, and Next.
evidence: The current page is in the primary's quiet fill and announced as current; the row keeps its length.
behaviour: Folds far pages into a gap.
Previous and Next disable at the ends.
context: Long lists split into pages. Keep the page in the address.
relationships: It belongs to the list above it.
accessibility: A <nav> with a label; aria-current="page"; each number named "Page n".
failures: Never loses the page on Back.
do: Put the page in the address.
